summary.en: Fed October meeting minutes released Wednesday showed near-unanimous support for further rate hikes, with some officials suggesting a move of more than 25bp at the next meeting; the Dow fell 1.1% to 50,198.17 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.2% to 7,323.63. Nvidia's fiscal Q3 report and raised FY2028 revenue growth outlook failed to halt a fifth consecutive session of losses after Chair Harvey Jones confirmed on the earnings call that Jensen Huang will not be reinstated as CEO. Premarket futures point higher (S&P +1.0%, Nasdaq-100 +1.7%) as TJX raised its full-year outlook and Target lifted its full-year sales guidance, though the 10-year yield ticked up to 5.085%.
summary.zh: 周三公布的联储10月会议纪要显示几乎所有官员支持进一步加息，部分官员提出下次会议可能加息超过25个基点；道指下跌1.1%至50,198.17，标普500微跌0.2%至7,323.63。英伟达（NVDA）第三季度财报及上调2028财年营收增长展望未能阻止股价连续第五日下跌，董事长Harvey Jones在财报电话会上确认Jensen Huang不会复任CEO。盘前期货走高（标普+1.0%、纳指100+1.7%），TJX上调全年展望、Target上调全年销售指引，但10年期美债收益率升至5.085%。

title.en: Fed October Minutes Show Near-Unanimous Support for Further Hikes; Dow Falls 1.1% to 50,198.17 as Nvidia Slides for Fifth Straight Session
title.zh: 联储10月纪要显示近乎一致支持进一步加息；道指跌1.1%至50,198.17，英伟达连续第五日下跌

impact.en: The hawkish minutes raise the bar for equity valuations, particularly rate-sensitive sectors, while the NVDA leadership transition and retail earnings strength (TJX +8.1%, Target +4%) create a mixed signal for the tech-led recovery.
impact.zh: 鹰派纪要抬高了股票估值门槛，尤其对利率敏感板块构成压力；英伟达（NVDA）管理层更替与零售板块财报韧性（TJX涨8.1%、Target涨4%）对科技股主导的复苏形成混合信号。

bullish: TJX raised its full-year financial outlook and Target lifted its full-year sales guidance on stronger-than-expected fiscal Q3 comparable sales. TJX上调全年财务展望，Target基于超预期的第三季度同店销售上调全年销售指引。
bearish: Fed minutes show near-unanimous support for further hikes, with some officials suggesting a move of more than 25bp at the next meeting. 联储纪要显示近乎一致支持进一步加息，部分官员提出下次会议可能加息超过25个基点。

macroRisk.en: Further rate hikes at next FOMC

title.en: FOMC Minutes Indicate Some Members Favored a 50bp Move at Dec 8-9; PANW Shares Rise 9.9% on Fiscal Q1 Report, UNH Falls 10%
title.zh: FOMC纪要显示部分官员倾向12月8-9日加息50个基点；PANW第一季度财报后涨9.9%，UNH跌10%

impact.en: The 50bp possibility at the December meeting sharpens the policy risk premium, while the divergence between PANW's 9.9% gain and UNH's 10% decline highlights sector-specific earnings risk. The 3.4M-barrel crude inventory build (ex-SPR) versus an expected 18K-barrel decline adds a mild headwind to energy equities.
impact.zh: 12月会议50个基点的加息可能性加大了政策风险溢价，PANW涨9.9%与UNH跌10%的分化凸显行业层面盈利风险。原油库存（不含战略储备）增加340万桶（预期减少1.8万桶）对能源股构成温和逆风。

bearish: UNH fell 10%, the largest Dow decline, as insurance stocks slumped. UNH下跌10%，为道指最大跌幅，保险板块整体走弱。

ai.en: NVDA's fiscal Q3 report and raised FY2028 revenue growth outlook were overshadowed by the Jensen Huang departure; the AI ETF (AIQ) was roughly flat (+0.03%) Wednesday. Anthropic's class A stock is expected to trade on Nasdaq under the ANT ticker on Thursday.
ai.zh: 英伟达（NVDA）第三季度财报及上调2028财年营收增长展望被Jensen Huang离任消息盖过；AI ETF（AIQ）周三基本持平（+0.03%）。Anthropic的A类股票预计周四在纳斯达克以ANT代码上市。

semiconductor.en: The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) edged up 0.27% Wednesday despite NVDA's fifth consecutive session of losses, suggesting the broader chip complex held relatively steady.

bigTech.en: PANW rose 9.9% on its fiscal Q1 report, the second-largest S&P 500 gain; the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.4% to 24,429.88, snapping a four-day losing streak.

keyRisk.en: Whether the 50bp-hawkish Fed minutes and the 10-year yield at 5.085% cap the premarket equity rebound, or whether breadth beyond mega-cap tech confirms a broader repair.
keyRisk.zh: 50个基点鹰派联储纪要及10年期收益率5.085%是否会限制盘前股市反弹，抑或大盘科技股以外的更广泛板块走强能确认全面修复。

note.en: Wednesday's mixed close (Dow -1.1%, S&P -0.25%, Nasdaq +0.4%) left the market in a fragile balance between hawkish Fed minutes and a resilient earnings tape. This morning's futures rebound (S&P +1.0%, Nasdaq-100 +1.7%) suggests an attempted repair, supported by PANW's 9.9% gain and retail strength, but the 10-year yield at 5.085% and the 50bp possibility at the December FOMC remain a headwind. The energy sector's 3.24% Wednesday decline adds a drag the broad bounce does not yet offset. I lean toward the tech-led bounce being fragile if breadth does not extend beyond mega-cap names. Watch whether the Nasdaq-100 premium over the S&P holds through the open and whether the 10-year yield stabilizes below 5.10%; a tech-only rally with yields drifting higher would weaken the repair thesis.
note.zh: 周三收盘涨跌互现（道指跌1.1%、标普500跌0.25%、纳指涨0.4%），市场在鹰派联储纪要与韧性财报之间处于脆弱平衡。今晨期货反弹（标普+1.0%、纳指100+1.7%）更像修复尝试，PANW涨9.9%和零售板块走强提供了支撑，但10年期美债收益率5.085%及12月FOMC可能加息50个基点仍是压力。能源板块周三跌3.24%构成额外拖累，宽幅反弹尚未覆盖。我倾向于认为，若涨幅未能扩散至大盘股以外，科技股主导的反弹较为脆弱。关注开盘后纳指100相对标普的溢价能否维持、10年期收益率能否稳定在5.10%以下；若仅科技股上涨而收益率继续走高，修复逻辑将被削弱。
